app.title: Molino — Photo to CNC
theme.title: Switch light / dark theme
lang.label: Language
step1.title: Upload & Adjust Image
step1.hint: Upload any photo. Adjust brightness, contrast, and color flip. Dark areas become deep cuts; light areas remain uncut. Drag the handles on the depth bar to choose which gray levels count as "no cut" and "max cut".
drop.label: Drop image here or <u>click to browse</u>
canvas.label: Preview (B&W depth map)
step2.title: Carve & Export
step2.hint: Change any parameter — the 3D preview, path plan and estimate update automatically.
units.label: Unit system:
p.spacingTitle: Distance between raster lines as a percentage of the tool diameter
p.maxRidgeTitle: Largest ridge (scallop) allowed between adjacent passes
p.retractTitle: Clearance used for short moves inside the carve area; safe height is used at start and end
viewer.leftoverTitle: Tint the surface where the target is deeper than this tool can reach
viewer.toolpathTitle: Planned tool path: red = cutting, blue = link through a finished groove, grey = rapid
viewer.hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to pan
export.placeholder: Adjust the parameters on the left; the preview appears here.
footer.note: No cookies. Images are processed in memory and never stored.
privacy.title: Privacy & browser storage
privacy.cookiesText: None. This app sets no cookies and has no accounts, analytics or tracking.
privacy.storageText: Two items, theme and lang, saved only when you press the theme button or pick a language, so your choice survives a reload.
privacy.imageText: Sent to this server only when you generate a preview or a download, processed in memory for that request and never written to disk.
privacy.thirdText: None. All scripts and assets are served from this server; nothing is loaded from a CDN.
privacy.logsText: Like any web server, the operator's server may log request metadata such as IP addresses for operation and security.
